current_scope_recheck.advanced_native_header_review: All 15 advanced PDF header portions identify sample material, without a year; oral sample dialect provenance comes from source/package labels. Together with the 20 newly recovered intermediate PDF headers, this is 35 header portions, not full-body or complete grade-rule review.
current_scope_recheck.archive_filename_encoding: The five original intermediate sample ZIPs use CP950 filename metadata without the UTF-8 flag. Explicit CP950 decoding yields 20 unique, portable relative PDF names; default CP437 decoding is incorrect. Source ZIP bytes are retained unchanged.
current_scope_recheck.compatibility: All 145 prior current source URLs, selectors, roles, canonical IDs, storage keys and checksums plus all 56 immutable revision references are conserved. Sample material alone changes 15 current advanced bundle identities; no active public Hakka assets exist.
current_scope_recheck.date_boundary: 題庫 resources are question banks; bank-plus-sample PDFs are practice collections; pure samples remain samples. Annual labels identify source editions, not administered sittings.
current_scope_recheck.historical_capture_boundary: Earlier source_gaps and primary_listing observations remain dated initial-capture evidence. The five pure 樣卷 parser omissions are now resolved; secondary-surface integration and broader identity/material/rights review remain incomplete.
current_scope_recheck.native_review_scope: Top portions of all 20 native first pages; all four skill headings and five dialect labels read. Full-body, full programme/grade rules and rights review are not claimed.
current_scope_recheck.publication: Existing Hakka publication and public-mirror-backup holds remain unchanged.
current_scope_recheck.rollback: Restore the Hakka adapter and provider data from baseline commit 535ea84355cd82a8a565563d9e17560e4363b374 or migration-baseline-state.tar.gz. Retain newly acquired sample originals separately; public site state is unchanged.

intentionally_excluded.general_support_materials: Undated proficiency standards and language-selection packages are supporting materials, not annual exam events.
intentionally_excluded.vocabulary_only_materials: Instructional lexicons and vocabulary audio are not examination questions, answers, or sample tests.

probe_policy.files_section_scope: Only current unretained URLs, source-only sample bundles, and alternate official question-audio packages are enumerated; retained exact primary files are summarized by listing hashes.

native_material_identity_recheck.bank_level_boundary: Download title/native covers identify 2018–2022 elementary-only resources, separate from the 2023 onward shared basic/elementary format. Legacy event and canonical keys remain compatibility selectors.
native_material_identity_recheck.dialect_boundary: Five supported source dialects are separate content variants. Two byte-proven cross-dialect label conflicts are isolated in review under catalog/mappings/hakka/native-conflicts-v1.json.
native_material_identity_recheck.immutable_history_projection: All 56 immutable revisions are projected without changing source facts. Ten checksum/title/source-key-backed legacy ODS labels resolve to the same-edition shared basic/elementary grade. The ungraded all-level rules package remains reference evidence requiring non-paper treatment; no current publication is added.
native_material_identity_recheck.material_boundary: 題庫 resources are question banks; bank-plus-sample PDFs are practice collections; pure samples remain samples. Annual labels identify source editions, not administered sittings.

Hakka publication/public mirror backup holds are unchanged.
native_material_identity_recheck.review_scope: Material type/date and native grade/dialect boundaries; cover/initial worksheet/member metadata review is not full-body linguistic or rights clearance.

retained_state_recheck.earlier_capture_is_historical: Initial-capture findings above are preserved as dated evidence, not current provider-state facts.

historical_source_recovery.remaining_review: Historical material meaning, undated identity, complete current acquisition and existing publication limits remain unresolved.
